scripts.compile:circuit: WORKSPACE=$(pwd) && cd circuits/vote && HOME=$WORKSPACE XDG_CACHE_HOME=$WORKSPACE/.cache-home nargo compile && mkdir -p ../../target && cp target/private_vote.json ../../target/private_vote.json
scripts.gen:verifier: bb write_vk -b target/private_vote.json -o target/vk -t evm && bb write_solidity_verifier -k target/vk/vk -o src/Verifier.sol -t evm --optimized
scripts.build: npm run compile:circuit && npm run gen:verifier && forge build
